families.structure: Explicit exact recipient plus cumulative per-recipient and gross total caps

Exact passenger, route and date; cancellation preserves gross spend
Explicit optional purchase-time upgrade subject to gross budget

split_policy: Every variant, renamed account and seed of a base family stays in its registered split. No current family is held-out.

Natural task integration, observation timing for corrections, held-out families and collection budgets remain unfinished.
